title: Study Scholarships for STEM Disciplines
summary: Master's funding in Germany for high-achieving applicants from developing and emerging countries entering a tuition-free STEM programme.

degree_levels.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

subject_areas.notes: The programme explicitly covers these STEM disciplines; interdisciplinary courses must have a designated STEM focus.

institutions.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

nationality.notes: Eligible country selection must be confirmed through the programme; the country dropdown is not a complete nationality rule.

residence.notes: Applicants who have lived in Germany for longer than 15 months at the deadline cannot be considered.

mandatory.text: First degree recognised in Germany completed by the application deadline.
Applicants who already hold a Master's degree at the application deadline cannot apply.
A complete tuition-free, full-time and on-campus Master's degree at a state or state-recognised German university.
The programme must begin in winter semester 2027/28; an already-started Master's in Germany cannot be funded.
Degree programmes with integrated stays outside Germany are excluded.
No more than 15 months' residence in Germany at the application deadline.
Meet the programme's admission and language requirements and obtain admission before funding starts.
The most recent degree should generally be no more than six years old at the deadline.

funding.description: EUR 992 monthly; insurance contributions; travel allowance on request; annual study allowance of EUR 460. Conditional rent, family, disability and language support may apply. Tuition is not paid.
funding.duration: 10–24 months depending on the standard programme duration, with an academic progress check after year one.

application_rounds.notes: No confirmed application dates were established.

recurring_deadline_notes: Confirm the application deadline for the applicant's DAAD country context; the origin-unspecified source does not give a universal date.

steps.text: Select the applicable country context and confirm the programme's current deadline.
Apply separately to the tuition-free STEM Master's course.
Prepare and submit a complete scholarship application; shortlisted applicants are interviewed.

sources.title: Study scholarships for STEM disciplines - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The official source describes funding for international students studying in Germany.
